q.en: A ship floats on water even though it is made of iron because:
q.as: জাহাজ লোহাৰে বনোৱা হ'লেও পানীত ওপঙে কিয়নো:

options.en: Its average density is less than that of water

explanation.en: The hollow shape gives a low average density, so the buoyant force supports the ship.
explanation.as: তপু আকাৰে কম গড় ঘনত্ব দিয়ে, গতিকে উত্থাপন বলে জাহাজক ধৰি ৰাখে।
